note: CRIM (Centro de Recaudación de Ingresos Municipales) publishes Puerto Rico parcel polygons (Parcelario, CRIM 2018, EPSG:32161) as ArcGIS services, but the sigejp.pr.gov and sige.pr.gov endpoints return 'Service crim/crim_parcelas/MapServer not started' (HTTP 500 JSON) on every query. The satasgis.crimpr.net parcel layers return 404 or are unreachable. The gis.pr.gov WFS (geoserver2.pr.gov pr_geodata) has no working CRIM parcel layer, and no Yabucoa-specific municipal parcel service exists. Only commercial sources (Regrid, landrecords.us) remain.
